facts.text: Pomona students can take classes at any of the undergraduate Claremont Colleges, which together offer more than 2,700 courses.
Students receiving financial aid at Pomona receive financial aid packages with no loans for eight semesters of enrollment.
Ninety-four percent of Pomona students choose to live on campus for all four years.
